signIn_subtitle: Sign in to your Soulbits Cloud account
signIn_browserHint: We'll open your browser to finish signing in.
pending_subtitle: Finish signing in in your browser. This screen continues automatically.
pending_expired: This sign-in request expired. Please try again.
pending_consumed: This sign-in request was already used. Please try again.
pending_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
storeGate_welcomeBody: Sign in to continue. Your conversations and AI companions stay in sync across your devices.
mode_description: Choose how you want to connect to Soulbits Engine
mode_selfhosted_desc: Connect to your own Soulbits Engine server on your local network
mode_cloud_desc: Connect through the Soulbits Cloud service
switch_warning_message_cloud: Switching to Soulbits Cloud will sync from your cloud session. Your self-hosted data stays on your device. Some provider settings (API keys) won't move between sources automatically — you may need to re-select them.
switch_warning_message_selfhosted: Switching to a self-hosted Soulbits Engine will sync from your local device. Your cloud data stays in your cloud session.
deviceAuth_message: We sent an authorization email to your address. Tap Authorize device in the email — or enter the code below.
deviceAuth_codeSentHint: Email sent — tap the button in it, or check your inbox for the code.
deviceAuth_waitingHint: Waiting for approval… this screen continues automatically once the device is authorized.
deviceAuth_invalidCode: Invalid code. Please check the email and try again.
deviceAuth_tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Please request a new code and try later.
deviceAuth_rateLimited: Too many code requests. Please wait a minute and try again.
deviceAuth_requestError: Could not send the code. Please try again.
deviceAuth_verifyError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
